source_title: Anatomy of the Human Body (1918), Plate 342
author: Henry Gray / 绘图 Henry Vandyke Carter
original_caption: Hip-joint, front view. The capsular ligament has been largely removed.
observation_zh: 右髋关节前方观（关节囊已大部切除）：股骨头、髋臼、圆韧带清晰可见；正常时股骨头深坐于髋臼内——脱位需高能量暴力的解剖基础。
observation_en: Anterior view of the right hip with the capsule largely removed: femoral head, acetabulum and ligamentum teres visible; the head sits deep in the socket — why dislocation needs high-energy trauma.
proves_zh: 正常髋关节的骨性结构关系
cannot_prove_zh: 脱位方向、复位方法；1918年解剖图谱，非影像

author: James Heilman, MD
original_caption: A superiorly dislocated hip post trauma
observation_zh: 骨盆正位：左侧股骨头向上移位、髋臼空虚，为创伤后上方脱位（上传者原标注圈出）。注意本例为上方脱位；临床最常见后脱位（约90%），读片要点相同——看股骨头是否在髋臼内。
observation_en: AP pelvis: left femoral head displaced superiorly with an empty acetabulum — post-traumatic superior dislocation (circled by uploader). Note: superior in this case; posterior (~90%) is most common clinically; the reading point is the same — is the head inside the acetabulum?
proves_zh: 脱位时“髋臼空虚、股骨头异位”的X线征象
cannot_prove_zh: 脱位方向分布（单例不能代表90%后脱位）；关节囊撕裂与坐骨神经状态
case_note: 独立病例；与图1-1、1-3非同一患者

author: Bill Rhodes (Asheville)
observation_zh: 股骨柄假体头脱出髋臼杯、向上移位。假体脱位可见金属部件，机制常与体位/假体位置/软组织张力相关，可发生于低能量，复发风险更高。
observation_en: Femoral stem head outside and above the acetabular cup. Metal components visible; mechanism often relates to position/component placement/soft-tissue tension, can follow low energy, higher recurrence risk.
proves_zh: 假体脱位的影像表现（假体头与臼杯分离）
cannot_prove_zh: 脱位原因（需结合体位史与假体位置评估）
case_note: 独立病例；与图1-2非同一患者

source_title: Anatomy of the Human Body (1918), Plate 245
author: Henry Gray / 绘图 Henry Vandyke Carter
observation_zh: 右股骨后面观：股骨头、颈、大小转子、骨干、内外侧髁；对照AO/OTA近端31、骨干32、远端33。
observation_en: Posterior view of the right femur: head, neck, trochanters, shaft, condyles; maps to AO/OTA proximal 31, shaft 32, distal 33.
cannot_prove_zh: 骨折本身；1918年解剖图谱，非影像

author: Hellerhoff
original_caption: Right femoral shaft fracture during bisphosphonate therapy for breast cancer: short, transverse fracture of proximal shaft with pre-existing thickening of the outer cortex (previous stress fracture).
observation_zh: 组合图（CT定位像+三维重建+术后X线）：右侧股骨近端骨干横形骨折，外侧皮质原有增厚；术后X线示髓内钉贯穿骨折端。注意：本例为双膦酸盐相关的非典型骨折（低能量），用于观察横形形态与髓内钉固定；创伤性股骨干骨折多为高能量。
observation_en: Composite (CT scout + 3D + post-op X-ray): transverse proximal shaft fracture with lateral cortical thickening; intramedullary nail spanning the fracture. Note: bisphosphonate-related atypical fracture (low energy), shown for transverse morphology and nailing; traumatic shaft fractures are usually high energy.
proves_zh: 横形骨折形态、髓内钉固定方式
cannot_prove_zh: 高能量创伤的典型表现；不能代表所有股骨干骨折病因

source_title: Anatomy of the Human Body (1918), Plate 350
author: Henry Gray / 绘图 Henry Vandyke Carter
observation_zh: 右膝关节矢状切面：股骨、髌骨、髌韧带、胫骨、半月板；伸膝装置链条：股四头肌腱→髌骨→髌韧带→胫骨结节。
observation_en: Sagittal section of the right knee: femur, patella, patellar ligament, tibia, meniscus; extensor chain quadriceps tendon → patella → patellar ligament → tibial tuberosity.
proves_zh: 伸膝装置的解剖连续关系
cannot_prove_zh: 骨折；1918年解剖图谱，非影像

source_title: Jarraya M et al., Imaging of patellar fractures, Insights into Imaging 2017
author: Jarraya M, Diaz LE, Arndt WF, Roemer FW, Guermazi A
original_caption: Two examples of transverse fractures in young adults. (a, d) Drawing, (b, e) anteroposterior radiograph, and (c, f) 3D CT surface reconstruction. (a–c) Non-displaced and (d–f) displaced transverse fractures through the body of the patella. Displaced fractures are associated with a higher risk of retinacular injury
observation_zh: 两名年轻成人横行骨折对照：上排（a–c）无移位，下排（d–f）移位伴分离；移位者支持带损伤风险更高。
observation_en: Transverse fractures in two young adults: top row (a–c) non-displaced, bottom row (d–f) displaced with separation; displaced fractures carry higher retinacular injury risk.
proves_zh: 横行骨折形态（无移位vs移位）、X线与CT互补
cannot_prove_zh: 伸膝装置查体所见；均为年轻成人，不代表老年骨质疏松骨折
case_note: 上排与下排为两名不同患者，绝非同一病例时序

source_title: Jarraya M et al., Imaging of patellar fractures, Insights into Imaging 2017
author: Jarraya M, Diaz LE, Arndt WF, Roemer FW, Guermazi A
original_caption: Patellar fracture of the lower pole in a 39-year-old man. (a) Drawing and (b) anteroposterior and (c) lateral radiographs show a transverse fracture of the lower pole of the patella
observation_zh: 39岁男性髌骨下极横行骨折；下极为关节外，常合并髌腱软组织损伤；侧位高位髌骨提示下极撕脱。
observation_en: Transverse fracture of the lower pole in a 39-year-old man; extra-articular, often with patellar tendon soft-tissue injury; patella alta suggests inferior pole avulsion.
cannot_prove_zh: 髌腱是否完全断裂（需超声/MRI）
case_note: 独立病例；与图3-2非同一患者

source_title: Anatomy of the Human Body (1918), Plate 349
author: Henry Gray / 绘图 Henry Vandyke Carter
original_caption: Head of right tibia seen from above, showing menisci and attachments of ligaments.
observation_zh: 右胫骨上端俯视：内侧半月板大而C形、外侧小而O形；对应内侧平台大而凹、外侧小而凸——外侧相对薄弱，劈裂塌陷好发于外侧。
observation_en: Superior view of the right tibial head: medial meniscus large/C-shaped, lateral small/O-shaped; matches medial large/concave vs lateral small/convex plateau — lateral split-depression predominates.
cannot_prove_zh: 骨折；1918年解剖图谱，非影像

author: LottieLattes
original_caption: Lateral Tibial Plateau fracture XRay with Depression
observation_zh: 膝关节正位（L标记）：外侧胫骨平台塌陷，关节面较内侧下沉、失去平整；典型的外侧劈裂塌陷。
observation_en: AP knee (L marker): depressed lateral tibial plateau with loss of articular flatness vs the medial side; typical lateral split-depression.
proves_zh: 外侧平台塌陷的X线表现
cannot_prove_zh: 塌陷精确深度（需CT）；软组织状态
case_note: 独立病例；与图4-1非同一来源

source_title: Anatomy of the Human Body (1918), Plate 357
author: Henry Gray / 绘图 Henry Vandyke Carter
original_caption: Coronal section through right talocrural and talocalcaneal joints.
observation_zh: 右距小腿关节冠状切面：胫骨延续为内踝、腓骨延续为外踝（两块独立骨），下胫腓骨间韧带位于两骨之间，距骨坐于踝穴内、胫骨穹窿之下。
observation_en: Coronal section of the right talocrural joint: tibia → medial malleolus, fibula → lateral malleolus (two separate bones); syndesmotic interosseous ligament between them; talus in the mortise beneath the tibial plafond.
proves_zh: 踝穴正常骨性结构（两块独立骨+联合+距骨）
cannot_prove_zh: 骨折或联合损伤；1918年解剖图谱，非影像

source_title: Tellisi N et al., OA Case Reports 2012;1(1), DOI 10.13172/2052-0077-1-1-288
author: Tellisi N, Abdulkareem IS, Giannoudis PG
original_caption: Frontal X-ray of a bimalleolar fracture. (Article: Combined ipsilateral calcaneal and bimalleolar ankle fractures treated by ORIF)
observation_zh: 踝关节正位：内踝骨折伴移位、外踝（腓骨远端）骨折，即双踝骨折；踝穴环两处断裂，多不稳定，常需ORIF恢复踝穴。
observation_en: Frontal ankle X-ray: displaced medial malleolar fracture plus distal fibular fracture — bimalleolar fracture; two breaks in the malleolar ring, usually unstable, often needs ORIF.
cannot_prove_zh: 下胫腓联合是否损伤（需应力位/CT）
case_note: 独立病例；与图5-1非同一来源

source_title: Incongruent reduction following post-traumatic hip dislocations as an indicator of intra-articular loose bodies: A prospective study of 117 dislocations (Indian Journal of Orthopaedics, 2011)
author: Karthik K / Sundararajan SR / Dheenadhayalan J / Rajasekaran S
original_caption: (a) X-ray of right hip joint (an anteroposterior view) showing posterior dislocation of hip in a 44-year-old male. (b) Postreduction X-ray (an anteroposterior view) shows noncongruent reduction: there is a broken Shenton’s line and increase in medial joint space. (c) CT scan shows the presence of an osteochondral fragment on the medial side of the joint. This was removed by open reduction. (d) A postoperative X-ray shows congruent reduction. The origin of the loose body was from the posterior lip of the acetabulum
observation_zh: 44岁男性车祸后右髋后脱位：(a)脱位正位X线示股骨头向后上脱出髋臼；(b)复位后Shenton线中断、内侧间隙增宽（复位不匹配）；(c)CT证实关节内侧骨软骨碎片（后经开放取出）；(d)取出后复位同心圆——"复位后常规CT"的直接影像依据。
observation_en: Posterior dislocation of the right hip in a 44-year-old man after a crash: (a) dislocated AP X-ray; (b) post-reduction broken Shenton's line with widened medial joint space (incongruent reduction); (c) CT confirms a medial osteochondral fragment (later removed openly); (d) concentric reduction restored after removal — direct imaging basis for routine post-reduction CT.
proves_zh: 后脱位的X线表现；复位不匹配征象（Shenton线中断）；CT发现游离体的价值；复位后同心圆确认。
cannot_prove_zh: 股骨头血供状态；坐骨神经状态（需查体）；股骨头骨折隐匿性（CT外层面）
case_note: 独立病例（Karthik等117例前瞻性研究中的1例；与本课程其他各图均非同一患者）——2026-10-04核验：文章署名CC BY（attribution license），Fig.1/2无第三方署名

source_title: Ipsilateral Foot Drop After Leg Traction on Fracture Table for Mid-Shaft Femur Fracture Nailing: A Rare Case Report (Cureus, 2023)
author: Alzahrani JA / Alabdali AA / Albariqi MO
license: CC BY (version not stated in original article)
original_caption: Preoperative radiographs of the right femur, revealing a closed femoral shaft fracture. Anteroposterior view (A and B); anteroposterior view of the pelvis (C).
observation_zh: 35岁男性100km/h正面撞击车祸后右股骨中段闭合骨折：(A)(B)股骨正位X线示骨干中段骨折、断端明显移位；(C)骨盆正位（术前评估一部分）——典型高能量创伤性股骨干骨折，对应课程"骨干32多为高能量暴力，肌肉牵拉使骨折端明显移位"。(原报告关注点为牵引床致同侧足下垂医源性并发症，本图仅取术前骨折影像。)
observation_en: Closed right midshaft femoral fracture in a 35-year-old man after a frontal crash at ~100 km/h: (A)(B) AP femur X-rays show displaced midshaft fracture; (C) AP pelvis (part of preoperative assessment) — typical high-energy traumatic femoral shaft fracture. (The report's focus is an iatrogenic traction-table foot drop; only the preoperative fracture images are used here.)
proves_zh: 高能量股骨干骨折的X线表现（断端明显移位）。
cannot_prove_zh: 同侧股骨颈隐匿骨折（需加拍髋部影像）；固定方式（本图为术前片）；术后足下垂并发症（不在本图）
case_note: 独立病例（35岁男性车祸，Cureus 2023；与本课程其他各图均非同一患者）——2026-10-04核验：文章署名CC BY，Fig.1无第三方署名
